observations: Photo 0: White Xbox One console with two controllers — one white, one blue — placed on top. The console has a perforated front panel and the Xbox logo visible on the bottom right.

Photo 1: Same console from a slightly different angle, showing the front with the disc slot and ports. The blue controller is in the foreground, white in the background. The console appears clean with minor surface marks.

Photo 2: Side view of the console with both controllers on top. The blue controller is on the left, white on the right. The console's side ports are visible. The console looks intact with no visible damage.
All photos show the console and controllers in good condition with no obvious cracks or dents. The controllers appear to be standard Xbox One models, not custom or third-party.
